title: Unique Peppery Syrian Beef Shin Stew
description: This peppery Syrian beef shin stew is a hearty and flavorful dish perfect for a date night, featuring tender beef shin in a rich and aromatic sauce. It is low in sodium and can be prepared with minimal effort.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the beef shin pieces and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the ground allspice, ground cumin, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the low sodium beef broth, tomato paste, and salt, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the stew, covered, for 2.5 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
